verdict.rationale: Clara's own marketing describes Clara Intelligence™ as real-time, AI-powered spend insights, an 'AI partner' that surfaces budget issues before they escalate, and an 'automated CFO agent' with predictive insights. That is a first-party, in-product AI insights capability, but it is backed only by brief homepage and product-page claims. The MCP server is for external assistants rather than in-product insights, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights and suggestions are generated and from which data, how users access them in the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
